description: Create Meta ad account. Spending/deletion: preview, then owner-approved confirm:true with the same requestId. Other edits: one call. Creates request active; report returned status and claim live only when active. Full field guide: soclo://tools/soclo_ads_create_ad_account.

accountId.description: The connected ad account in Soclo.

adAccountId.description: Advertiser/ad account selected from your Soclo connection.

confirm.description: True only after owner approval of spending/deletion preview.

expectedBudgetAmount.description: Approved preview amount; changes require a new preview.

expectedBudgetType.description: Approved preview budget type: daily or lifetime.

businessId.description: Business portfolio that will own the account.

currency.description: Uppercase ISO 4217 currency supported by Meta.

fundingId.description: Existing Meta funding reference. Does not add a payment method.

invoice.description: Request Meta invoicing. Eligibility is determined by Meta.

mediaAgency.description: Media agency business or page ID. NONE for self-serve customers.

name.description: Ad account name. Whitespace is trimmed.

partner.description: Partner business or page ID. NONE for self-serve customers.

requestId.description: Reuse this request ID for confirmation and outcome recovery.

name: soclo_ads_create_ad_account
title: Create Meta ad account
